title: MuSK Myasthenia 1000 Study
official: Genome Wide Association Study of Patients With Muscle Specific Kinase Myasthenia Gravis
summary: The MuSK myasthenia gravis 1000 study seeks to collect saliva samples from 1000 subjects with laboratory confirmed diagnosis of MuSK myasthenia to identify genetic variations associated with MuSK MG. The data collected may be used by researchers to gain a better understanding of the cause of MuSK MG and to identify biomarkers and targeted therapy for MuSK MG.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Lab test confirming diagnosis of MuSK myasthenia gravis
* Willingness to provide saliva sample via mail or in person

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to provide informed consent
* Unwillingness to provide lab results of elevated muscle specific kinase antibody
* Unwillingness to provide saliva sample
